findings.original: the bourgeoisie has bound the proletariat, comes nowhere
findings.rewrite: the proletariat [the class of wage workers, who own nothing they can live by except their labor-power]

findings.fix: the proletariat [the class of wage workers]

notes_review: The logged calls are sound (relay-system explanation, Dogberry identification, keeping capital's masculine pronouns, the past-tense narration of the court cases, and the typo fixes). Note 1's open question is settled by §7.0: a quotation-only first use gets the first clause of the §7 wording as a bracketed gloss, so the gloss is shortened.
summary: Fidelity is high. Ure's two definitions, the subject/object inversion, the factory-code polemic, and both court cases keep every figure, attribution, and ironic tag. The prose reads plainly and keeps Marx's sarcasm ("Pindar of the automatic factory", "factory Lycurgus", "worthy employer").
